doc: Regressions accepted on purpose. compare.py does not fail on a worse metric listed here while the head value stays within the limit. Fields: metric (component.metric), scope ("total" or a dataset id; default total), limit (the worst head value accepted), reason. An accepted total also accepts that metric's per-dataset rows. Remove an entry once the change is on main: the base then contains it and the entry accepts nothing.

accepted.reason: Issue #310: the outcome account and contrasts on the planted target joined a report already saturated at the 100-finding cap (191 functional statements past their group cap alone); the target_driver shape statement (interestingness 0.6289) falls just below the head selection cut (0.6387). found_4k total improves 55 -> 56 across the gate. Record: docs/benchmarks/2026-11-17-pointed-mode.md.

Issue #374 step 4: the predictive screen's holdout and fold splits are now seeded from each target column's value histogram instead of its position, so reordering or renaming columns no longer changes the models (invariance.reverse 191 -> 87, rename 0 -> 0, total 319 -> 238). Adding a column or shuffling rows still moves the drivers each model names above 5% of gain; the new seeds draw a different realization of that pre-existing instability. Record: docs/benchmarks/2026-11-18-identity-order.md.
